## Checklist (Definition of Done)
- [ ] Every acceptance criterion is met and proven by a test or a named manual check
- [ ] Browser tests pass on desktop and phone sizes, with no accessibility violations
- [ ] Coverage hasn't dropped; the user flows touched are marked covered
- [ ] Each bug fix has a test that failed before the fix
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` and `RELEASE_NOTES.md` updated
- [ ] Docs updated (README, decisions, services) where affected
- [ ] Checked on the `dev` preview
- [ ] No secrets, real data or personal details in the diff
